text:
People Ops: Quick follow-up thread from today's all-hands Q&A — drop any remaining questions about reviews, leveling, promotions, comp, equity, or benefits and we'll answer here. :sparkles:

Marta G: Two things: 1) Is there a standard manager template for promo justification? 2) How does equity cliff/vesting get affected if promo includes a title change?

People Ops: 1) Yes — use the short promo template (summary, 3 impact bullets, evidence links, recommended band + effective date). Link: https://intranet.redwood.example/promo-template. 2) Promotions do not change existing grant terms automatically. If a manager requests a new grant as part of the promo, comp will coordinate with total rewards; vesting start dates are handled case-by-case.

Owen L: Any update on compensation transparency? Can ICs see band medians / comp ranges?

Luis (CFO): We publish band ranges and medians in the handbook for transparency. Individual salaries remain private. If you want market context for your role, request a comp discussion with your manager + comp partner.

Priya S: If someone misses the current promo window but clearly met the bar, what's the recommended path? Retro? Fast-track?

People Ops: Start with a retro nomination (manager submits evidence + peer feedback). We offer fast-track review for clear misses; expect ~10 business days if complete. If timing is tight for retention, flag in the submission and we'll expedite.

Maya (CTO): On calibration fairness: we're piloting a two-step process next cycle. Step 1: blinded evidence + rank. Step 2: names revealed for calibration discussion. Also training for managers on bias reduction will be mandatory this quarter.

Marta G: Benefits question: any change to open enrollment windows or voluntary benefits (commuter, FSA) this year?

People Ops: Open enrollment unchanged (first week of November). New this year: optional commuter pre-tax payroll deduction and increased FSA carryover from $500 -> $550. Details will be in the benefits doc next week.

Owen L: 401(k) match? Is match vesting changing?

People Ops: 401(k) match remains 4% with immediate vesting. No changes this year.

Priya S: Appeals timeline — I'm curious about SLAs for leveling disagreements.

People Ops: Appeals window = 14 days after outcome. SLA: acknowledge within 3 business days, decision within 10 business days. If comp committee review needed, up to 21 business days. We'll message case updates in-thread.

PeopleOps Bot: Promo checklist snippet: 1) One-line rationale, 2) Top 3 measurable impacts, 3) Evidence links, 4) Proposed effective date, 5) Manager sign-off. Template: https://intranet.redwood.example/checklists/promo

People Ops: We'll synthesize these answers into a short FAQ and post to the handbook tomorrow. If you want private help, book office hours: https://calendar.redwood.example/peopleops-officehours — thanks all! :clap:
